children: ZetaChain's ZetaLabs opens on Solana on December 9, 2026, bringing live markets and AI models together in one chat. ZETA powers the product, and the announcement also includes the token's move to Solana.

ZETA's move gives the token direct exposure to the Solana ecosystem. The change affects holders and liquidity by shifting the token to the network where ZetaLabs offers its combined market and AI chat product.
Private AI is coming to Solana in 30 days.
On Dec 9, ZetaLabs opens: live markets and leading AI models in one chat, powered by ZETA.

title: ZetaChain: ZetaLabs launches on Solana as ZETA moves to the network - 09 Dec 2026
